literature_name: Faecalibacterium duncaniae (strain A2-165, formerly named Faecalibacterium prausnitzii)
name_note: Most genomes GTDB places here carry the NCBI name Faecalibacterium prausnitzii; the strain A2-165 lineage was renamed F. duncaniae, and Faecalibacterium hominis was shown to be a later synonym of it.

sentences.text: Faecalibacterium duncaniae, the species of strain A2-165 and formerly called Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, is a rod-shaped, non-motile bacterium that is extremely sensitive to oxygen.
It belongs to one of the most abundant genera of the human gut microbiome and produces butyrate.
The species is developed as a next-generation probiotic and makes a microbial anti-inflammatory molecule that is processed and exported at its cell envelope.
Faecalibacterium hominis, which shares 99.0 per cent 16S rRNA identity with the type strain, was shown to be a later synonym of Faecalibacterium duncaniae.
